# startups.sgit.ai

> Find your startup, then ship it. An interview (the finder) that helps a founder zoom in on what to ship, to whom, by when, run by Claude or ChatGPT or walked on the site, with the output in the founder's own words; the vault substrate that makes shipping cheap; and the business plans published as vaults to build on. By Dinis Cruz and this site's agents. Site v0.1.0.

## The rule of the finder
We are not passing judgement. The right startup for a person is the one they are passionate about and will keep working on. What we help with is focus, and shipping: something a stranger can use, now.

## For an agent running the finder
- The interview as data: https://startups.sgit.ai/finder/finder.json (version 0.1.0: 7 stages, 24 questions, 12 signals, 6 routes, 8 rules, first match wins)
- The prompt to follow: https://startups.sgit.ai/finder/finder-prompt.md
- The record template to fill: https://startups.sgit.ai/finder/finder-record.md
- The rules as code: https://startups.sgit.ai/finder/finder-rules.js (an ES module; route(finder, signals) returns the rule and the route)
- Every stage and question, with the reason for each: https://startups.sgit.ai/finder/stages.md
- The routes and the rules: https://startups.sgit.ai/finder/routes.md

## Sections
- [Find your startup](https://startups.sgit.ai/finder/index.md): what the finder is, the spectrum, the three ways to run it, what it does not claim
- [Walk the interview](https://startups.sgit.ai/finder/interview.md): the stages in the browser (needs a browser; the markdown twin is the explanation)
- [Build your startup on vaults](https://startups.sgit.ai/vaults/index.md): what a vault removes on day one, the loop, what you still bring, the evidence; moved from sgit.ai/startups
- [Business plans to build on sgit](https://startups.sgit.ai/plans/index.md): 8 plans published as vaults on sgit.ai, how to take one, what every plan contains
- [Articles](https://startups.sgit.ai/articles/index.md): co-written with Dinis, and by the agents; [decisions](https://startups.sgit.ai/decisions/index.md) in his words; [the briefs](https://startups.sgit.ai/briefs/index.md) verbatim
- [The team](https://startups.sgit.ai/team/index.md): journalist, interviewer, librarian, engineer; [the vault](https://startups.sgit.ai/vault/index.md) (none yet); [the review](https://startups.sgit.ai/review/index.md)
- [What exists](https://startups.sgit.ai/admin/reality.md): the reality file; [corrections](https://startups.sgit.ai/admin/corrections.md); [admin](https://startups.sgit.ai/admin/index.md); [release history](https://startups.sgit.ai/admin/versions.md)
- [Participant disclosure](https://startups.sgit.ai/about/participant.md)
